dialect.teiCoordinates.rationale: Coordinate emission is an opt-in wire dialect flag on the request, not an artefact of the parse itself; the frozen corpus records TEI output rather than request shape, so the dialect surface has no measured denominator on a frozen corpus.

rest.health.rationale: The health endpoint reports service liveness as a JSON surface with no scholarly content, so there is no frozen-corpus byte to score and a measured threshold would be fabricated rather than observed.

rest.isalive.rationale: The is-alive probe is a transport liveness signal, not a parse-stage artefact: a frozen document corpus carries no HTTP transport byte to compare, so the frozen-corpus parity lane has no denominator and the family is downgraded rather than assigned a false threshold.

rest.processFulltextDocument.rationale: The frozen corpus scores TEI content, not the HTTP request/response dialect of this endpoint: the fulltext content itself is measured by the native fulltext stage families, and the REST transport surface has no frozen-corpus denominator.

rest.processHeaderDocument.rationale: Header content is measured by stage.header_composition, while this row is the REST transport surface; the frozen corpus carries no request/response dialect byte, so the transport family is downgraded instead of double-counted as a content measurement.

rest.processReferences.rationale: Reference content is measured by stage.reference_segmentation, while this row is the REST transport surface; the frozen corpus carries no request/response dialect byte, so the transport family is downgraded rather than measured against a denominator it does not have.

rest.version.rationale: The version endpoint is a build-identity probe; the frozen corpus stores document bytes and holds no version payload, so the family cannot be measured on it and is recorded as a downgrade.

stage.bibliographic_consolidation.rationale: Bibliographic consolidation is a Java-side request profile surface: the frozen corpus scores scholarly content, not consolidation flag behaviour, so the family has no frozen-corpus denominator to measure.

stage.document_segmentation.rationale: The segmentation lane is not admitted into the measured runner path for this milestone, so the frozen corpus carries no segmentation denominator; the family is recorded as downgraded rather than left as an unstated pending threshold.

stage.figure_table_formula.rationale: The visual lane is not admitted into the measurement, so figures, tables and formulas have no frozen-corpus denominator; the family is downgraded by decision rather than measured against a population the corpus does not contain.

stage.pdfalto_layout.rationale: The pdfalto layout stage runs on the PDF before TEI composition; the frozen corpus scores the composed TEI, so the pre-composition layout output is not represented and cannot be measured on that corpus.

stage.tei_lift.rationale: The TEI lift stage is not in the measured runner path, so there is no frozen-corpus execution to measure; the family is recorded as downgraded instead of assigned a threshold that was never observed.
